metrics_definition.recall@5: macro mean over qrel queries: |retrieved top 5 intersect relevant| / |relevant|
metrics_definition.ndcg@10: macro mean graded DCG@10 / ideal DCG@10; gain=2^relevance-1, discount=log2(rank+1)
metrics_definition.mrr@10: macro mean reciprocal rank of first relevant item in top 10

unjudged_caveat: Unjudged retrieved documents are not established non-relevant; BEIR qrels are incomplete judgments.
